content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Jesse Stewart (E013)
Request: admin access to Payroll

Facts:
- Role: Payroll Specialist
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

The requested level is admin. For contractors, admin is never allowed. So maximum is read (since they only have basic training, not advanced). So grant the maximum which is read.

Requested level (admin) is above the maximum (read), so grant the maximum = read.

Submit decision: read.
